purpose: Test whether the residual surface intervention produces preregistered focus-axis effect size on a fresh synthetic episode while removing the PA6 length mismatch.

design.source: fresh synthetic work not used in R76/PA6 and unrelated to H1 real works
design.architecture: one newly frozen episode architecture shared byte-identically by Control and Treatment

arms.Control: 40K+ surface realization under the pre-residual PA6/R76-style realization policy without the new residual intervention.
arms.Treatment: 40K+ surface realization under the same architecture plus the residual intervention below.

design.matched_length_rule: Both arms must be >=40,000 chars. Absolute difference should be <=10% of the shorter arm; otherwise paired result is descriptive only and cannot satisfy PA7 qualification.

treatment_residual_intervention: POST_ACTION_SUMMARY_SUPPRESSION: after a visible action already establishes a state change, do not append an abstract sentence restating its meaning unless new causal information is added.
PROCEDURE_TRANSACTION_DEDUP: adjacent scenes may not repeat record/confirm/disclose/custody actions unless the repeated action changes authority, risk, relationship, or available choice.
VOICE_ORTHOGONALITY: preserve distinct sentence length, diction, directness, avoidance, humor, status strategy, and institutional vocabulary per principal even in procedural scenes.
EMOTIONAL_COUNTERPRESSURE: high-information scenes must contain a playable interpersonal cost or asymmetry rather than becoming neutral process simulation.
ENDING_COMPRESSION: after the dramatic climax, retain only closure actions that materially change state carry; avoid serial explanatory sorting beats when the screenplay already evidences the state.
DIRECTION_ECONOMY: stage directions must be playable and specific but may not paraphrase dialogue or summarize theme.

gates.mechanical: Both arms >=40K; same architecture; metadata leak 0; no full-scene duplicate; valid receipts and hashes.
gates.absolute: Treatment whole mean >=7.0 for >=2/3 judges; Treatment surface mean >=7.0 for >=2/3; no critical violation confirmed by >=2 judges.
gates.paired: Treatment surface preference wins >=2/3; whole preference wins+ties >=2/3.
gates.focus: Treatment pooled median not lower on CHARACTER_VOICE, DIALOGUE_SUBTEXT, PHYSICALIZATION_ACTION, KOREAN_SPOKEN_NATURALNESS; at least 4 of 6 frozen focus axes pooled median delta >=+0.5.
gates.recoverability: Treatment premise, major threads, sequence progression, relationship trajectories, and due/deferred boundary recoverable by >=2/3 judges.

external_blind.pre_frozen_scene_sample: Must be selected and sealed before either arm surface is generated.

no_posthoc_rule: Do not weaken +0.5 threshold, change focus axes, replace the sample, or alter judging rules after first arm output.
promotion_boundary: PA7 can qualify the provider-analog rehearsal layer only. It cannot promote Production/Runtime/Level-3/R140 or substitute for real-provider PM0/C/T.
